vc_checking.summary: All seven cleaned manual obligations are semantically derivable from the current annotation and case-lib seed. The implementation obligations reconstruct the circular doubly-linked-list shape after one of four pointer-update branches; the two public-contract derivations instantiate the dispatch contract with the caller's existing head and node sequence. No witness requires a generated-file or seed-spec change.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: The linklist variable cell, xizi_dll head_dispatch_case nodes_dispatch_case, and a disjoint standalone xizi_dll_node linklist_node_pre.
vc_shape.pre_pure: xizi_double_link_insert_after_anchor head_dispatch_case nodes_dispatch_case linklist_pre, hence In linklist_pre nodes_dispatch_case or linklist_pre = head_dispatch_case.
vc_shape.pre_exists: Opening xizi_dll yields sentinel first/last fields and a dllseg for the complete abstract node list.
vc_shape.post_spatial: One of four exact internal cuts: member with nonempty suffix, member with empty suffix, sentinel with nonempty list, or sentinel with empty list, while preserving the variable cell and new-node ownership.
vc_shape.post_pure: Nonnull head/new-node facts, the relevant list decomposition, first-occurrence exclusion, dispatch-result equality, and branch equalities/non-null facts.
vc_shape.post_exists: Instantiate nodes_before/nodes_after and neighboring pointers for a member anchor; or instantiate old successor/first/last for the sentinel cases.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: For the member branch, use the first-occurrence split nodes_dispatch_case = nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: nodes_after, split the opened dllseg at that occurrence, and then case-split nodes_after into nil or old_next :: rest. For the sentinel branch, set linklist_pre = head_dispatch_case and case-split nodes_dispatch_case into nil or old_next :: rest; the opened xizi_dll supplies all fields.
witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_dll_open, prove that the stop sentinel is absent from its dllseg, split the dllseg at the first member occurrence, and expose the first node of a nonempty suffix. xizi_dll_node supplies both fresh-node fields and its non-null fact. Field ownership disjointness supplies the node inequalities required by dllseg guards.
witnesses.pure_plan: Destruct the anchor proposition. In the member case, derive head not in nodes from the opened cyclic segment, obtain a first-occurrence list split, simplify dispatch on linklist_pre <> head_dispatch_case, and use the insert-after first-occurrence equation. In the sentinel case, simplify dispatch at equal anchors. No arithmetic assumption beyond pointer-field address separation is invented.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec or abstract-program refinement is present; this is a direct spatial/list entailment.
